name: MEDIATORE
description: Mediatore is an Italian trick-taking game for four players, closely related to Tressette. It features a unique bidding system where the final bidder plays alone against a team of three, or chooses a partner by calling a card. The game uses a 40-card Italian deck and includes a 'monte' of undealt cards that can improve the bidder's hand.

content.text: Mediatore is an Italian trick-taking game for four players, closely related to Tressette. It features a unique bidding system where the final bidder plays alone against a team of three, or chooses a partner by calling a card. The game uses a 40-card Italian deck and includes a 'monte' of undealt cards that can improve the bidder's hand.
Mediatore is a variant of Tressette, one of Italy's most popular card games. It developed as a way to add bidding complexity to the base game, allowing for more strategic depth.
4 players, playing individually or in variable partnerships based on bidding.
40-card Italian deck (or standard deck minus 8s, 9s, 10s). Suits: Coins, Cups, Swords, Clubs. Ranking: 3 (high), 2, Ace, King, Queen, Jack, 7, 6, 5, 4 (low).
40-card Italian deck or modified standard deck.
9 cards to each player in batches of 3. The remaining 4 cards form the 'monte' (talon) placed face down.

items.text: Tressette: The parent game with fixed partnerships and no bidding.
Restricted Mediatore: Some variants restrict which cards can be called (e.g., only 3s or 2s).
